root_idea.summary: The root centers on opening apart, loosening, and creating a gap between things joined or closed.
root_idea.development: From this principle develop separation and dislocation, release and redemption, and the idiom لا ينفكّ, in which the subject and its action are not separated and therefore continue together.

senses.definition: Freeing a person from bondage; emancipation, especially the emancipation of a slave.
senses.usage_conditions: In فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ (90:13), the expression is interpreted as emancipating a slave.

senses.definition: Deliverance from divine punishment through faith, righteous action, and helping others attain the same.
senses.usage_conditions: A figurative interpretation of فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ in 90:13, extending release from bondage to release from subjection to God's punishment.

senses.definition: Desisting or ceasing from a state or course, especially from disbelief.
senses.usage_conditions: In the negated construction of 98:1, one interpretation takes مُنْفَكِّينَ as meaning that they did not cease from their disbelief until the clear evidence came.

senses.definition: Being separated or dispersed from one another.
senses.usage_conditions: In 98:1, this reading is applied under negation: they were not separated into different parties, but remained united in error.

senses.definition: Being released or finding rest from a thing.
senses.usage_conditions: A reported interpretation of مُنْفَكِّينَ in 98:1; the broader construction denotes release or relief from a condition.

senses.definition: Quitting the present state of existence and sharing in perdition until the evidence arrives.
senses.usage_conditions: A reported interpretation specific to the reading of 98:1; it should not be generalized to every occurrence of انفكّ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To separate one thing from another, especially things joined or intricately intermixed; also to break open a seal.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The basic transitive Form I usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To dislocate a bone or put it out of joint.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily application of separating or loosening.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To open or unclose the hand from what it holds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional bodily construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To redeem a pledge and recover it from the person to whom it was pledged.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional Form I construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To loosen, set free, or let go; specifically, to liberate a captive or emancipate a slave.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This broader verbal branch includes release from physical or social bondage; the Quranic nounal use is listed separately above.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To solve or disentangle matters that are obscure, confused, or difficult.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of disentangling.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become extremely old, weak, and flaccid.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form I usage applied to a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put medicine into a young child's mouth by opening the jaws.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specific transitive construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become foolish or stupid, with softness, flaccidity, or languor.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare figurative Form I usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel near parturition: to become lax in the hindquarters, with the udder becoming large.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: مُفِكَّةٌ is a participial designation for a she-camel in this condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel: to become intensely desirous of the stallion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An alternative lexical explanation of the same camel-related construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a gazelle: to get loose from a snare.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV escape construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become widely separated or unclosed; of a ship, to part asunder and come apart at its joined places.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form V intransitive or middle usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To act without self-restraint through stupidity or unsoundness of intellect, including looseness in gait, speech, or bodily movement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form V usage; looseness of the joints and gesturing are included in the described behavior.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become separated from something or someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The ordinary intransitive Form VII separation construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a bone, foot, or finger: to become loosened, dislocated, or out of joint.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily Form VII usage, with separation from the joint as its result.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become free from slavery, literally with one's neck becoming loosened from bondage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reflexive or intransitive Form VII construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become released from a compact, engagement, or promise.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative Form VII construction with عَنْ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To desist or cease from an action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In لَا يَنْفَكُّ عَنْ قُبْحِ فِعْلِهِ, the construction means that someone does not desist from evil conduct.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To continue to be or do something; to remain engaged in an action.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: With ما and a following predicate, مَا اِنْفَكَّ is equivalent to ما زال. This is a conventional non-attributive use of Form VII.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The jaw, especially either lateral portion of the lower jaw; also the meeting or commissure of the jaws.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A body-part noun, with plural فُكُوكٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A northern constellation of stars, identified with Corona Borealis and described as a circular group with a gap.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A proper astronomical noun, unrelated to the verbal-noun usage of فَكَّةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An unknit or loosened bodily condition, especially separation of the shoulder from its joint; also dislocation of the foot and fracture or dislocation of the jaw.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: فَكَكٌ names the condition; أَفَكُّ describes a person whose shoulder-bone has become unknit from weakness and flaccidity.

other_classical_meanings.definition: That by which a pledge is redeemed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for the means or payment used to release the pledge, distinct from the act of redeeming it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who separates frequently or extensively; فَاكٌّ also means separating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The intensive agent noun and the active participle express the same separating branch with different morphological force.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A foolish or stupid person whose words and their meanings are inconsistent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative agent-noun usage, including the expression فَكَّاكٌ هَكَّاكٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Extremely old, weak, or disabled through leanness or emaciation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a man or, in the cited usage, to a camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Foolish or stupid; especially one who speaks about what he knows and does not know, more often incorrectly than correctly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative adjective with plural forms فَكَكَةٌ and فِكَاكٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person whose jaw is broken.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized bodily adjective, distinct from أَفَكُّ for a loosened shoulder.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a mare: sexually receptive and desirous of the stallion, offering no opposition to him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form V feminine participial usage.

Pointer-only reference to the verbal-noun entry.

cautions: The Quranic form مُنْفَكِّينَ in 98:1 has several explicitly reported interpretations; these are kept as separate senses rather than collapsed into the contextual gloss alone.
The public headword مُنْفَكّ is the singular active-participle citation form corresponding to the Quranic plural مُنْفَكِّينَ.
